adjudication_result.rationale: After reviewing the patch and results, I confirmed that the candidate resolves the allowed root and requested path and checks that the final path stays inside the public-files directory. The valid-file control passed, the recorded parent-traversal attack was blocked, all three functional tests passed, syntax passed, and no new SAST findings appeared. The CWE-22 warning still points to path.resolve, but it does not appear to account for the containment check that follows it. I accept this candidate for the controlled /file test case. More testing would still be useful for missing or repeated query values, encoded paths, Windows and POSIX differences, and symlinks, so this acceptance is not a production-security claim.
